data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (prior year comparative) was GBP 77.553m. During 2017 there was adverse prior-year development resulting in an increase in claims provisions (net reported movement GBP 53.801m), driven predominantly by reserve deterioration in property and third party liability classes. Management notes the impact of US hurricane events (Harvey and Irma) on loss experience and records some foreign exchange effects; the net quantified prior-year movement reported in the notes is used here (gross was not separately presented), therefore the movement is recorded as a strengthening of reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: Loss experience has been impacted by the US hurricane events of Harvey and Irma in the 2015 and 2016 years of account, although the estimates at year end remained within the syndicate's reinsurance retention and substantially below initial estimates.
The syndicate does not have exposure to Hurricane Maria.
The 2015 YOA has incurred a foreign exchange loss of GBP 2.7m, arising mainly from the matching of exposure to the Euro.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement (movement in prior year's provision) was presented in a dedicated gross column; the notes provide a clear reconciliation of technical provisions and a net prior-year movement breakdown. The prior_year_development_gbp_m used above is the NET movement quoted in the notes (total GBP 53,801k) because no explicit gross PYD figure was available; this is flagged as a fallback. The claims development triangle is present (gross and net) but detailed gross prior-year diagonal changes were not used as primary source due to potential distortions (RITC activity) and to follow the report's explicit narrative. Users should treat the prior-year movement as net-of-reinsurance unless a gross movement is located.
